_comment: Identities that are known to be running unaudited, and are deliberately not
gated in index.json. fleet_drift.py lists these separately and does NOT count
them as drift, so that a permanent open item cannot redline the signal and
train everyone to ignore it. A new identity appearing is the alarm; a known
one staying open is a backlog entry.
Adding an entry here is a decision to keep publishing without covering it, so
each one carries a reason and, where a page exists that explains the gap, a
link to it. Removing an entry is what happens when the gap closes.
This file is NOT part of the frozen path spec and no client reads it.

acknowledged.reason: Liveness undecidable from the signed log: the entry is a superseded revision on the glm-5-3-flash gpu03 CVM whose containers a later up of another file either removed as orphans (shared compose project) or left in place (per-model project); the log records no project. What it declares cannot be serving: the V12Q8 replicas that answer today reserve the same GPUs. Decided by garry 2026-11-06 ('acknowledge gpu03') after the nine comparable gpu23/four-CVM leftovers were reviewed to the same 'superseded, not running since' outcome. log-pinned up on gpu03 2026-09-23; superseded by the TP2x4 W4AFP8 lineage (V12Q8 904054f5 serving since 2026-10-29)
acknowledged.closes_when: near.ai records the compose project (and an env-overlay hash) in the compose_up/compose_down action, or exposes the live container list, so liveness becomes derivable; or the revision is reviewed
